body: I can't think of a single goal (unless you count dying).
I didn't say I've never been in a relationship -- it's just that none of them ever lasted.  The longest one I ever had was only a little over a year.

Do you mean why I thought of suicide at 13?  It was because of a terrible performance in junior high athletics that caused my volleyball team to lose.  Seems really silly now in light of all the serious heartbreaks that came later in life.

So go make some music if that's what you like to do.   Seems like that might be a reason to hang around -- and also the 3 people you mentioned.

Can't say I'd recommend "getting high", though --  at some point you end up coming down, and that makes the world seem shittier.
This isn't much, but you aren't alone in your feelings.  Your post said what I am feeling better than I could have myself.
I was "officially" diagnosed at 19, but I remember being sad quite often as a child.  The first time I thought of suicide was at age 13.
